name: Fully differential amplifier
summary: Processes an analogue input to provide two complementary output signals around a defined common-mode level.
description: Processes an analogue input to provide two complementary output signals around a defined common-mode level.

On a schematic, identify the input network, output common-mode control and two output terminals and trace the differential output pair and ADC/load interface. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
Two output terminals distinguish a fully differential amplifier from a single-ended-output difference amplifier.
